verses.text: A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.

xrefs.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.

verses.text: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.

xrefs.text: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

verses.text: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.

xrefs.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

verses.text: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—

xrefs.text: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.

verses.text: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.

xrefs.text: and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and exalt and glorify the King of heaven, for all His works are true and all His ways are just. And He is able to humble those who walk in pride.

verses.text: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.

xrefs.text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.

Nebuchadnezzar declared, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent His angel and delivered His servants who trusted in Him. They violated the king’s command and risked their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

verses.text: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.

xrefs.text: I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God.

verses.text: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.

xrefs.text: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

verses.text: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.

xrefs.text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?”
Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.

verses.text: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.

After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.

verses.text: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,

xrefs.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

verses.text: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.

xrefs.text: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

verses.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.

xrefs.text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

Of the increase of His government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.
The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

verses.text: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

xrefs.text: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.

verses.text: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.

xrefs.text: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.

verses.text: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

xrefs.text: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?

verses.text: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.

xrefs.text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.

verses.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.

xrefs.text: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.

verses.text: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.

xrefs.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.

verses.text: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.

xrefs.text: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

verses.text: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.

xrefs.text: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
